name: Minecraft Server Manager
description: Self-hosted control panel for Minecraft servers that run as Docker containers on the itzg/minecraft-server image. Guided server creation, pinned modpacks with rollback, Modrinth/CurseForge/Hangar browsing, live console, backups, schedules, crash analysis and multi-user roles.

notes.text: First-run setup asks for a 6-digit PIN. Get it inside the container with: journalctl -u minecraft-server-manager | grep -o '"pin":"[0-9]*"'
Game servers publish their own ports from 25565 upward (Bedrock from 19132). Size RAM and disk for the servers you plan to run.
The panel controls Docker in this container, so its admin login is root-equivalent here. Do not expose it to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy.
